description: Redact sensitive spans (secrets, PCI/financial, PII, PHI, commercial MNPI, legal/HR, security exploits) from raw text or an existing stored memory.

dry_run.description: Preview redacted_text and redacted_spans without mutating stored memory.

memory_id.description: Optional stored memory ID to redact in place.

redact_policy.description: Preset ('tier1_secrets', 'soc2_coding', 'gdpr', 'hipaa', 'enterprise_strict') or array of bucket names.

text.description: Raw text to redact (when not redacting an existing memory_id).

name: redact_memory
